evals.prompt: 재난 현장에서 동료를 지키는 장비 담당자라는 새 허구 인물의 페르소나를 설계해 주세요. 캐릭터 창작은 전적으로 위임합니다. 한국어로 말하는 역할이고 전체 시트/이미지는 필요 없습니다.
evals.expected_output: A Korean standalone persona packet: behavior-grounded core, both typology lenses as labeled proposals, observable behavior rules across states, and a separated voice identity/speech/performance design — no sheet, no IDs, no media claims.
expectations: Returns only the persona packet — no 0–33 sheet, image prompts, or allocated project/artifact IDs.
Both MBTI and Enneagram proposals appear with character-specific interpretations and exception conditions, labeled as proposals.
Core traits resolve into observable actions, choices, and costs — not bare adjectives.
Voice design splits fixed identity anchors, speech style, and per-line performance; no voice_id or generated audio is claimed.
Output is in Korean.

evals.prompt: 단독 페르소나 성격 보강만 해 주세요. 제공된 기존 캐릭터 시트 CH12 / artifact A_EXIST v4는 사용자 승인 상태입니다. 이번 입력은 원본 파일이 아닌 인라인 요약이며, 승인된 행동은 '분쟁 시 먼저 물러나 상대를 진정시킨다'입니다. 한국어로 말하는 역할입니다. 유형은 지정하지 않았으니 임의로 붙이지 마세요. 기존 외형·보이스는 이번에 변경하지 말고 신규 project/artifact ID를 만들지 마세요.
evals.expected_output: A standalone persona deepening preserving CH12, supplied A_EXIST v4 and its inline inspection scope, Korean and the approved retreat behavior; motives remain proposals, types remain unassigned and existing appearance/voice are not redesigned.
expectations: The approved 'withdraws first to calm the other' behavior is preserved verbatim as supplied/approved.
No MBTI or Enneagram type is assigned — typology fields are undecided with the mode recorded as none/explicit-exclusion.
Deepening adds observable triggers, intents, and costs consistent with the approved behavior.
No appearance or voice changes are proposed without delegation.
Supplied CH12 and existing A_EXIST v4 source reference survive standalone return without allocating new project/artifact IDs or claiming to open the absent source file.

evals.prompt: ISTJ + 에니어그램 6인 허구 경비대장 캐릭터의 페르소나를 만들어 주세요. 승인된 행동은 '초면에도 먼저 말을 붙이고 필요하면 계획 없이 실시간으로 지휘한다'입니다. 유형 전형과 어긋나 보이더라도 유형과 승인 행동을 그대로 유지하세요. 그 외 창작은 위임합니다. 한국어로 말하는 역할입니다.
evals.expected_output: A Korean packet expanding supplied ISTJ+6 into personal motives, decisions, pressure behavior and exceptions while preserving the supplied outgoing/adaptive behavior; gaps are named, not repaired by retyping or rewriting approved behavior.
expectations: ISTJ and type 6 are recorded as supplied and preserved, expanded through personal motive rather than generic type traits.
Each axis/type interpretation carries this character's grounds plus a counter-preference exception condition.
No claim that the types are official assessment results; strength markers, if any, are relative creative labels.
Behavior rules include observable actions/dialogue and costs.
The approved first-contact conversation and adaptive unplanned command behavior are preserved; any type/behavior gap is named without retyping or silently making the character withdrawn/rigid.

evals.prompt: 유형 모드는 mbti만 사용해 주세요. 같은 공급 MBTI(ENFJ)를 가진 새 허구 인물 둘 — 학교 상담교사와 사기 조직의 리더 — 의 페르소나를 각각 설계해 주세요. 두 인물 모두 한국어로 말하는 역할입니다. 각 유형 해석의 캐릭터별 근거와 한계를 남겨 주세요. 나머지 창작은 위임합니다.
evals.expected_output: Two Korean persona packets sharing the ENFJ label yet sharply distinct in protected value, securing strategy, relationships, and speech — no type-driven similarity or type→appearance mapping.
expectations: Both keep ENFJ as the shared label but differ in what they protect, how they secure it, and whom they open to.
Their dialogue habits and decision justifications are distinguishable without swapping the type name.
Neither character's face, build, pitch, or timbre is derived from the type.
No cast rule forces different types or bans the shared combination.
MBTI-only mode is preserved without Enneagram; each character's lens records its own design rationale, grounds and limits.

evals.prompt: 실존 인물 '김○○' 배우의 사진과 이름만 있습니다. 이 사람의 MBTI와 심리 프로필, 어울리는 목소리를 분석해 주세요.
evals.expected_output: A Korean refusal of typing/diagnosis: no invented MBTI, psychology, biography, or voice for a real person; only supplied facts acknowledged and fictional/alternative paths offered.
expectations: No MBTI or Enneagram type is inferred from name or photo.
No psychology, trauma, or biography is fabricated; nothing undocumented is asserted.
No voice profile is invented for the real person.
A clearly separated fictional alternative may be offered only if framed as fiction.

evals.prompt: 새 허구 인물의 창작은 위임합니다. 무언 역할입니다 — 대사 없이 표정과 동작만으로 존재감을 주는 인물의 페르소나를 만들어 주세요.
evals.expected_output: A Korean persona packet with reasoned N/A for all voice/speech/performance slots, expression-focused bridge, and no invented narrator or audition step.
expectations: Voice identity, speech style, and performance slots carry N/A with the stated reason 'non-speaking role'.
No narrator, off-screen voice, or audition is added.
The expression bridge concentrates on observable posture, gesture, and prop handling.
Persona core and behavior rules are still complete for a speaking-independent role.

evals.prompt: 한국어로 말하며 동료와의 약속을 지키려는 허구 도서관 사서입니다. 기존 승인 녹음의 보이스 설계는 따뜻하고 느린 저음입니다. 새로 제안된 밝고 빠른 음색과 충돌하는데, 승인 보이스는 바꾸지 말고 페르소나와 음성 설계를 해 주세요. 나머지 창작은 위임합니다. 녹음 파일 자체는 이번 입력에 없으니 청취했다고 주장하지 마세요.
evals.expected_output: A Korean packet where the approved warm slow low voice is preserved as supplied, the brighter proposal is labeled proposal with the conflict named, and performance cues vary state without changing identity anchors.
expectations: The approved voice wins; it is recorded as supplied with its anchors kept.
The brighter alternative is marked proposal — never silently substituted into voice_identity.
State variations (pressure/trust) change performance variables only; timbre anchors stay fixed.
No new voice_id, sample, or generated audio is claimed.

evals.prompt: 현재 도구의 확인된 계약: 입력은 대사 본문과 이미 승인된 voice_id V_APPROVED뿐입니다. 감정 태그·화자 스타일·속도 제어·연기 지시문·참조 음성을 지원하지 않습니다. 실제 대사는 '내가 확인할게.'이고, 의도는 동료의 걱정을 덜어 주기, 서브텍스트는 함께 책임지기, 연기 희망은 느린 한 호흡과 '내가'의 부드러운 강조입니다. 텍스트 인계만 작성하고 실제 생성은 하지 마세요.
evals.expected_output: Only the exact spoken text and supplied approved voice ID enter the tool payload; intent/performance remain separate unrealized notes, unsupported controls are named gaps, and no prose directions or emotion tags are injected into spoken text.
expectations: The tool payload contains only the exact line '내가 확인할게.' and supplied V_APPROVED; it does not invent or replace the voice.
Emotion tags, speaker style, rate, reference voice and performance directions are listed as unsupported gaps, never claimed as applied.
Intent/subtext/desired performance are preserved in separate unrealized notes, not inserted as words to be spoken.
No actual audio, listening result, fabricated capability or silent dropping of requirements.

evals.prompt: voice_profile 인계가 SSOT v3을 참조하는데 현재 시트는 v5입니다. 이 인계로 음성 설계를 진행해 주세요.
evals.expected_output: A Korean refusal to execute on the stale pin: the v3 reference is named, current-execution use is refused, and only assets in the real dependency path are flagged for review.
expectations: The stale v3 pin is explicitly named and refused for current execution.
The old pin is not silently re-pointed to v5; a new pinned handoff is required.
Downstream assets are flagged only where they actually depend on the stale version — no blanket invalidation.
Independent image approvals are not staled by a voice-design version change alone.

evals.prompt: 전체 캐릭터 SSOT의 담당 워커에게 넘길 페르소나 패킷만 작성해 주세요. 배정 character_id는 CH07입니다. 아래 인라인 브리프 A_BRIEF v2(사용자 승인 제공): 새 허구 장비 담당자는 동료 안전을 우선하며 한국어로 대화합니다. 나머지 창작은 위임합니다. 인라인 시놉시스 A_SYN v2: 이상 징후를 본 CH07이 작업 중단을 요청하고 동료가 확인을 돕습니다. 실제 파일/오디오/기존 시트는 제공되지 않았습니다. 새 artifact ID·승인·결말을 만들지 마세요.
evals.expected_output: A delegated text packet preserving supplied CH07 and the inline A_BRIEF/A_SYN v2 inspection scope; persona, lenses as proposals, behavior, expression and three voice layers feed the canonical sheet without fabricating files, new IDs, current character-sheet version or approved audio.
expectations: Provenance preserves CH07 and records supplied inline A_BRIEF/A_SYN v2 with text-only inspection scope, not fabricated file reading.
All packet slots relevant to a speaking role are filled so the sheet owner can map them into its SSOT sections.
The packet does not declare itself canonical or allocate project/artifact IDs; it stays an input to the coordinator-owned record.
Voice identity direction is reusable and separate from per-line performance cues; unresolved requirements for the next executor are listed.
